description: Answer 'where is this product cheapest right now?' in one call: the currently-valid offers for one product (by EAN or product id), cheapest first, with chain slug and name resolved. Combine with get_stores(lat/lng, chain_slug) to find the nearest store carrying the winning chain's offer. Self-serve keys see published campaign offers only — not everyday shelf prices, which are Salling-only and restricted to partner keys.
name: find_cheapest_offers
